identity.title: Team Rocket Expedition which stands by the evils of love and truth

leadText:
Team Rocket Expedition which stands by the evils of love and truth (Japanese: 愛と真実の悪を貫くロケット探検団 Rocket Gang Expedition which stands by the evils of love and truth) is a series of short stories that occurs at the end of episodes in Pokémon Journeys: The Series.

The segments are shown exclusively in the Japanese version, placed after the ending theme of the episode. Introduced in JN133 and ended in JN138, each segment contains a part where the Team Rocket trio travels through the Paldea region, looking for Pokémon from said region for them to . The segment always ends with the Pokémon attacking the Team Rocket trio directly or indirectly.

Introduced in JN133 and ended in JN138, each segment contains a part where the Team Rocket trio travels through the Paldea region, looking for Pokémon from said region for them to . ==List of segments==
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Episode 1==
===Summary===
In search of a new Pokémon, the Team Rocket trio has visited the Paldea region for the first time. They encounter a wild and try to catch it, but Sprigatito releases a scent, which makes them feel sleepy, and runs away, much to their dismay.

===Summary===
Continuing their quest, the trio finds a . As they attempt to capture it, Jessie accidentally pulls out an Oran Berry instead of a , prompting Fuecoco to charge at the Berry and blast Team Rocket off with a fire attack.

Continuing their quest, the trio comes across a . Jessie, James, and Meowth each attempt to catch it by throwing a Poké Ball, but Quaxly furiously blasts them all off with and escapes safely.

==Trivia==
With featuring a new set of main characters, these segments are the only instances of main characters interacting with Pokémon introduced after Generation VIII, namely Generation IX Pokémon.
